install_configuration.reason: Otherwise req_llm loads a .env file from the working directory when its application starts under Mix.

contract: Gemini API generateContent provider of integration/ai-text with an API key, through req_llm 1.31's documented google provider-callback API, for the evidenced model gemini-3.8-flash only (other models refused invalid_request): max_retries 0, one HTTP exchange with the body bounded to 4 MiB of wire bytes while received and every response halted by an Elzoo step (no redirect, no retry, no req_llm error value); key only from the injected Need, sent only in x-goog-api-key; features tools, structured output and image input (inline_data, png, jpeg, webp, gif); sampling, stop sequences, reasoning and cache hints not declared; system messages only before the others, one systemInstruction part each; function calls and responses carry the neutral call id, a failed tool result as the response's error key; each tool's parameter schema unchanged in parametersJsonSchema, a root other than type object refused unsupported_feature; structured output as responseMimeType application/json with responseJsonSchema unchanged, a schema with a keyword outside the reference's supported list (oneOf excluded, as the reference reads it as anyOf), a $ref other than #/$defs/<name>, $id or $defs below the root, or a cyclic $ref refused unsupported_feature; structured output with tools, a final model turn and a final Gemini turn (the trailing user and tool-result messages) without non-empty text, unless it is tool results only, refused; finish STOP stop or tool_calls, MAX_TOKENS length, SAFETY, PROHIBITED_CONTENT, BLOCKLIST, SPII and IMAGE_SAFETY refusal (also as a prompt blockReason), other reasons {:other, reason}; usage from usageMetadata with output candidates plus thoughts and absent counters :unknown; status table 400 provider_invalid_request (400 with ErrorInfo reason API_KEY_INVALID authentication_failed), 401, 403, 404, 413, 429 throttled, 503 overloaded, 504 provider_timeout, other provider_error; retry_after for 429 and 503 from Retry-After, else RetryInfo retryDelay rounded up, nil over 86,400 s or malformed.
limits: Stub evidence only (R5): conformance to the documented format as fetched 2026-11-24, never live behaviour, output quality, latency, safety filtering, rate limits or prices; no live call was made.

Requests are validated against a schema hand-derived from the Gemini API generateContent OpenAPI document fetched 2026-11-24 (not an official JSON Schema); only the members this Piece sends are admitted; conformance beyond them is not claimed.

The fetched reference lists responseJsonSchema beside responseFormat and marks the JSON-schema output field deprecated in favour of responseFormat; this Piece sends responseJsonSchema as its Contract states, and its continued acceptance is an upstream assumption.

The generateContent error page documents 400, 402, 403, 404, 429, 499, 500, 503 and 504; 401, 413 and 503 meaning overload rest on the google.rpc.Code HTTP mapping and are policy exercised on stubs; 402 (Prepay credit depleted) is provider_error by the Contract's table.

Replayed function calls that Gemini did not sign carry req_llm's thoughtSignature, the base64 encoding of skip_thought_signature_validator; the Thought signatures page names the bare string for history from other sources. Real signatures are not kept by the neutral request.

One model (gemini-3.8-flash), one API surface (generateContent on the Gemini API), an API key only; Vertex AI, streaming, batch, more models, reasoning, cache hints, sampling and stop sequences are refused or not supplied.
The documented 20 MB request size limit for inline data is not checked locally: the host's image_bounds must keep base64 image data under it; an oversized request gets the provider's error status.

Every consumer must merge config :req_llm, load_dotenv: false into its configuration: the line is declared in install_configuration and written into the generated install file, but the copier never edits a consumer's configuration. The credential invariant holds regardless: only the injected key is used.

grounding.claim: Every captured stub request is validated with jsv against this schema hand-derived from the Gemini API generateContent OpenAPI document (https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference/generate-content.openapi.json, v1beta, fetched 2026-11-24, source SHA-256 a11386534137dfde9430553b9ee63ffc25a2c6e41908e5192cabcb650252773c), plus method, path, empty query, the injected key only in x-goog-api-key and absent sampling, stop and thinking fields; deviations are asserted to be rejected by it. Not an official specification.

Listed scenarios against in-process function-plug stubs: the interface conformance kit and its image scenario; undeclared features refused before any request; a mixed transcript (system parts, function calls and responses with ids and the error key, tool choice); refusals of shapes generateContent cannot express exactly; images of each media type in order; finish and usage mapping; each status of the table, Retry-After and retryDelay forms, a redirect, malformed and oversized bodies, timeout and closed transport, one request each; a body req_llm did not encode with one part per neutral call and tool result not sent; models outside the table and bad provider configurations refused before any request; redaction in results, inspect, owner state and debug logs; ambient keys never used; fixture provenance and negative controls; source audit of this Piece's own manifest-listed files; the README's Install configuration line. Finite scenarios, no live call, not proofs.

req_llm 1.30.0 (Hex checksum 1c4b19608aa982de5ea396cc6de3d3738e72480182ba11c184e028a4af305edb) Google provider: prepare_request(:chat) to POST /models/<id>:generateContent under https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta, x-goog-api-key from api_key, encode_body/1 for contents (inline_data images, functionCall with a skip thoughtSignature, functionResponse), function declarations, toolConfig and maxOutputTokens; observations of the pinned version, not guarantees.
llm_db 2026.11.0 model metadata for google:gemini-3.8-flash: active, input modalities including image, tools enabled, native JSON schema output.
Req 0.7.5 response and error steps, Req.Request.halt/2, the into: collector and the :plug test transport.

Gemini's live API behaves as the reference fetched 2026-11-24 describes (generateContent OpenAPI document, API errors (generateContent), Thought signatures, Function calling, Structured output, Token counting); 503 means overload and a 429 or 503 is a rejection that authorizes no redispatch; an absent usageMetadata counter is unknown even though proto3 JSON may omit zero values; the API accepts the dummy thought signature base64-encoded, as Part.thoughtSignature (format byte) is sent; the host keeps the key Need truthful.

telemetry.contract: No Elzoo event. req_llm may emit its request start event (payload capture off by default) to consumer-installed handlers; response-side events are not emitted because every response is halted. Own events through runtime/telemetry: future task.

config.contract: Construction-time provider term (optional HTTPS base URL; a test plug), fixed max_retries 0, evidenced model table, receive timeout and model allowlist from the interface Config, key from the injected Need; no hot reconfiguration.

control.contract: Call-scoped; dispatch, rearm and expiry are the delivery/effect-intent owner's Control.
